actual_checks: Full prompt, API/meta, report, author/source records and full prior body read. The contribution covers the complete smooth closed aspherical dimension-4 and dimension-5 strata with nonnegative-scalar rigidity, while the earlier all-dimensional announcement is not accepted or extended to dimension >=6.

Exact Theorem 2 requires no spin, orientability, positive-b1 or special nonpositive-sectional-curvature metric assumption. Asphericity is the topological contractibility of the universal cover; the obstruction ranges over every smooth metric.

Nonnegative scalar curvature forces full curvature tensor zero, stronger than no everywhere-positive scalar metric. Contrapositive: any nonflat metric has negative scalar curvature somewhere. A different smoothing preserves underlying asphericity; theorem applies to every available smoothing without claiming all topological manifolds smoothable.

Finite covers preserve closedness and the contractible universal cover. Curvature pulls back under local isometries; flatness descends by surjectivity, so an orientation-cover argument would add no hypothesis. No noncompact/boundary or higher-dimensional extension is inferred from the imported dimension-sensitive mu-bubble proof.
